changelog: v0.4.6: 1) Whisper STT English-Only Model Parameter Fix: removed task and language arguments from Xenova/whisper-tiny.en invocation, resolving the Quest 3 transcription exception; 2) Active Stage Reset on STT Error/Silence: guaranteed setActiveStage('idle') transition in Whisper catch blocks and no-speech flows to eliminate prolonged 'Whisper Transcribing' hung warnings; 3) Neural Voice Session Pre-Warming: added warmVoice() during background init and avatar switching to eliminate the 14s first-sentence ONNX graph compilation lag, achieving instant ~1.4s speech synthesis.
